description: Header file defining the ProcessGroupNCCL class for NCCL-based distributed communication in PyTorch, including nested classes for work management, options, debugging, and watchdog mechanisms.

classes.name: WorkNCCL
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous NCCL work item, managing execution, error handling, and debugging.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Configuration options for ProcessGroupNCCL, including priority, splitting, and NCCL-specific settings.

classes.name: DesyncDebugger
classes.description: Handles desynchronization debugging for NCCL operations.

classes.name: HeartbeatMonitor
classes.description: Monitors NCCL process health via heartbeat signals, manages debug info collection.

classes.name: Watchdog
classes.description: Checks for NCCL errors and timeouts, aborts processes if necessary.

methods.name: checkForNCCLErrors
methods.description: Checks for NCCL errors on a communicator, can be overridden for testing.

methods.name: initWork
methods.description: Initializes a WorkNCCL object for a specific device and operation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the monitor or watchdog thread.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins the monitor or watchdog thread.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop for monitor or watchdog to check NCCL status.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Signals the monitor or watchdog to wake up or perform actions.
